HOMONYM WARNING: the Good and Evil alignment DOMAINS are proper nouns rendered 'Bene' and 'Male' (e.g. "Dominio del Bene", "Dominio del Male") — read out of Manuale del Giocatore, Cleric Deity/Domains entry ("un dominio di allineamento (Bene, Caos, Legge, Male)"). This collides with the shared glossary.json's STRICT en_case 'Good'->'Buono' / 'Evil'->'Malvagio' (the alignment ADJECTIVE), which still fires whenever capitalized 'Good'/'Evil' appears in a domain list, because English uses the same capitalized word for both the domain name and the adjective. Correct translation of a domain list cannot satisfy both at once. Known, unavoidable false positive, same class as 'familiar'/'Gnome'/'keen'/'Enchantment'.
